title: Detailed magnifying glass
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Handle -->
  <rect x='58' y='62' width='24' height='10' rx='4' fill='#3a2a1a' transform='rotate(45 70 67)'/>
  <rect x='60' y='63' width='20' height='6' rx='2' fill='#7a5a2a' transform='rotate(45 70 66)'/>
  <rect x='62' y='64' width='16' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#c49a4a' transform='rotate(45 70 65.5)'/>
  
  <!-- Handle knob / connector -->
  <circle cx='56' cy='60' r='5' fill='#8a6a2a'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='60' r='3' fill='#c49a4a'/>

  <!-- Lens rim (outer ring) -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='38' r='28' fill='#4a4a6a'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='38' r='26' fill='#7a7aaa'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='38' r='24' fill='#3a3a5a'/>
  
  <!-- Lens glass -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='38' r='22' fill='#5a9adf' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='38' r='22' fill='#8ac4ff' opacity='0.3'/>
  
  <!-- Lens highlight (glass shine) -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='30' rx='8' ry='10' fill='#c8e8ff' opacity='0.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='28' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- Small secondary highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='48' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#b0d8ff' opacity='0.35'/>
  
  <!-- Rim inner highlight -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='38' r='24' fill='none' stroke='#a0a0cc' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='38' r='27' fill='none' stroke='#9a9acc' stroke-width='1'/>
  
  <!-- Rim shading detail - bottom arc -->
  <path d='M 22 52 A 24 24 0 0 0 58 52' fill='none' stroke='#6a6a9a' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Reflection streak on glass -->
  <path d='M 28 18 Q 35 14 42 16' fill='none' stroke='#e0f0ff' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Small bright spot on lens edge -->
  <circle cx='52' cy='28' r='2' fill='#d0e8ff' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
